semantic_contract.economic_sequence: frozen V3 collapse zone -> lower regime -> causal pre-entry approach -> frozen first return and E1 completed signal bar -> next legal minute E1 entry -> clean legal U resolution or unresolved severe tail
semantic_contract.mission: rank future E1 trade quality using only zone relevance, capital memory, approach cleanliness, and first-contact information known no later than E1 signal-bar close
semantic_contract.global_approach_start: frozen postcollapse_low_cal_idx; no hindsight local-low finder
semantic_contract.daily_feature_cutoff: completed sessions with cal_idx strictly less than E1 acceptance cal_idx
semantic_contract.contact_cutoff: frozen completed E1 acceptance bar, inclusive
semantic_contract.entry_clock: unchanged next legal executable minute open strictly after acceptance bar

feature_dictionary.global_path_efficiency: (last pre-signal coordinate close - global-start coordinate close) / sum absolute coordinate close changes from global start through last pre-signal session; null if denominator<=0
feature_dictionary.recent10_path_efficiency: same net/path formula over exactly the last 10 completed pre-signal sessions
feature_dictionary.recent10_pullback_burden: maximum peak-to-subsequent-trough coordinate-close drawdown in recent10 divided by (L/minimum recent10 coordinate close-1); null if denominator<=0
feature_dictionary.down_day_share_10: negative coordinate-close transitions divided by nine recent10 transitions
feature_dictionary.higher_low_state: minimum coordinate low in last five recent10 sessions versus minimum in first five; exact stored-coordinate comparison
feature_dictionary.zone_age_sessions: E1 signal cal_idx - primary zone formation cal_idx
feature_dictionary.global_approach_speed: (L/global-start coordinate close-1) divided by number of sessions from global start through last pre-signal session
feature_dictionary.late_acceleration: recent five-session coordinate-close return minus preceding five-session return, using the first/middle/last closes of recent10
feature_dictionary.cum_turnover_since_zone: sum authoritative PIT turnover_fraction from formation_cal_idx+1 through signal_cal_idx-1; no volume or future-float reconstruction
feature_dictionary.contact_close_location: (acceptance raw close-raw low)/(raw high-raw low); null for zero range

outcome_blind_bins.tercile_rule: 33.333333% and 66.666667% empirical quantiles over feature-complete 538-event Development population, computed and hashed before any outcome column is read
outcome_blind_bins.target_distance_control: reuse anatomy outcome-blind LOW/MID/HIGH target_net_distance terciles

directional_contrasts.risk_outcome: negative of unresolved_d60 and severe_unresolved_d60 differences so positive always means better

verdict_implementation.material_dimension: at least two of: clean_resolve_20 quality contrast>=5 percentage points, u_before_loss10 quality contrast>=5 points, unresolved_d60 quality contrast>=3 points, severe_unresolved_d60 quality contrast>=3 points
verdict_implementation.date_robust: reentry-date-equal and formation-date-equal clean20/u-before10/unresolved contrasts preserve expected sign for at least two of three metrics and at least 50% of the event-weighted absolute contrast in aggregate
verdict_implementation.year_stable: expected sign on at least two of clean20/u-before10/unresolved in at least five Development years with both comparison groups N>=3; at least six supported years required
verdict_implementation.board_stable: expected sign on at least two of clean20/u-before10/unresolved for both MAIN and CHINEXT with each comparison group N>=10
verdict_implementation.control_robust: expected sign on at least two of clean20/u-before10/unresolved in at least two target-distance terciles and in both layer structures where comparison groups N>=10
verdict_implementation.approach_supported: recent10 efficiency or pullback burden is material and passes date, year, board, and control robustness
verdict_implementation.memory_supported: zone age or cumulative turnover is material and passes date, year, board, and control robustness
verdict_implementation.structure_present: approach_supported and memory_supported, or one supported dimension plus another material dimension and a supported primary surface with severe-unresolved improvement
verdict_implementation.primarily_approach: approach_supported, memory not supported, and no contradictory primary surface
verdict_implementation.primarily_freshness: memory_supported, approach not supported, and no contradictory primary surface
verdict_implementation.weak_or_unstable: at least one material pooled dimension or primary surface exists but no supported verdict above
verdict_implementation.no_structure: no material pooled dimension and no primary surface with >=8 percentage-point clean20 or u-before10 contrast plus >=3-point severe improvement
